title: Airlines with more than 20 flights
statementMd:
Which airlines operate more than 20 flights? Show the code and count.

Expected columns: `airline_code`, `flights`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT airline_code, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flights GROUP BY airline_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
